alt: An annotated screenshot of the Wesley Health Centers (JWCH) 'Virtual Tour' page. It displays virtual tours for seven different regional clinics, but a red annotation box highlights that there is zero representation or virtual tour for their local Palmdale or Lancaster facilities—confirming the systemic 'SPA 1 drought' and regional neglect of the Antelope Valley. Additional boxes highlight HRSA health awards and their Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA) malpractice coverage status.

Image Annotations:
1. Red box over clinic virtual tours list: '...there's no virtual tour of the local Palmdale/Lancaster clinics. SPA 1 drought confirmed.'
2. Yellow box over 'Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA)' footnote: 'At least they're open about this unlike some others.'
